clue.text: Greatly enjoy describing driver well ahead of the competition?

definitions.meaning: to relish something eagerly, as a cat laps milk

definitions.text: driver well ahead of the competition?
definitions.meaning: a racing driver who has lapped the field is a whole circuit in front, read playfully as a phrase

explanation.surface: A motor-racing fan savours watching a driver who has pulled clear of the rest of the field.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is whimsical, hence the question mark: a driver one lap ahead of the others is 'a lap up'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to receive something with eager pleasure, like praise or attention.

clue.text: Rented one incredible resort to relax

parts.note: let means rented out
I is the Roman numeral one
a tall story is hard to believe

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to behave without inhibition, to unwind completely.

clue.text: A bit open, but not ultimately ajar

explanation.definitionFit: A part or portion, like a slice or fragment.

clue.text: Leader concerned with source of money provided in support

clue.text: Flower child initially wrapped in flannel

explanation.definitionFit: A common yellow meadow plant of the genus Ranunculus, an example of a wild bloom.

clue.text: Gift sees expression of disapproval over note

parts.note: hark means listen

clue.text: Involve the writer in upset over British fuel

clue.text: Boy imprisoned by those people, say, makes regular complaint
